scheme_name: Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship For Scheduled Caste Candidates
other_conditions: Must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) category
Must have passed the post‑graduation examination in the concerned subject
Must be registered for a full‑time M.Phil. or Ph.D. programme
Must be pursuing full‑time research without having obtained a JRF from UGC‑NET or UGC‑CSIR NET
Transgender candidates are eligible to apply
Reservations will be applied as per Government of India norms
benefits_summary: Provides a five‑year fellowship with a monthly stipend (₹25,000–₹28,000) and additional allowances for eligible SC/ST candidates pursuing M.Phil. or Ph.D.
